vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you live in a house or an apartment?
idioms: Home is where the heart is - "Uy - yurak qayerda bo'lsa, o'sha yerda"
sentenceStarters: "I currently live in..." - "Men hozirda ... da yashayman"
"I've been living there for..." - "Men u yerda ... dan beri yashayman"
"The apartment/house is quite..." - "Kvartira/uy juda..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
I currently live in an apartment in the center of Tashkent. It's a modern three-bedroom flat on the fifth floor of a high-rise building.
I've been living there for about four years now with my family. The apartment is quite spacious and has all the modern amenities we need, including central heating and a nice balcony with a city view.
While I do enjoy apartment living for its convenience and security, I sometimes dream of having a house with a garden. As they say, "Home is where the heart is".
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men hozirda Toshkent markazida joylashgan kvartirada yashayman. Bu ko'p qavatli binoning beshinchi qavatida joylashgan zamonaviy uch xonali uy.

Men oilam bilan taxminan to'rt yildan beri shu yerda yashayman. Kvartira juda keng va bizga kerak bo'lgan barcha zamonaviy qulayliklarga ega, jumladan markaziy isitish va shahar manzarasi ko'rinib turadigan chiroyli balkon.

Men kvartirada yashashning qulayligi va xavfsizligidan rohatlansam-da, ba'zan bog'i bor uyga ega bo'lishni orzu qilaman. Aytishlaricha, "Uy - bu yurak joylashgan joy".

Shuningdek, bu biz oila sifatida yig'iladigan, suhbatlashadigan va mehmonlarni qabul qiladigan xona. Bu haqiqatan ham uyimizning yuragi.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Which room do you spend the most time in?
idioms: A good night's sleep is worth its weight in gold - "Yaxshi uxlash oltinga teng"
phrases: unwind after a long day - "uzoq kundan keyin dam olmoq"
sentenceStarters: "I probably spend the most time in..." - "Men ko'proq vaqtni ... da o'tkazaman"

questions.sampleAnswer:
I probably spend the most time in my bedroom, especially during evenings and weekends.
Besides sleeping, I use my bedroom as a personal workspace. I have a desk there where I prepare lessons, grade papers, and do online research. It's become my private retreat where I can focus without distractions.
Additionally, I enjoy relaxing there by reading or listening to music before bed. It's my sanctuary where I can unwind after a long day. As they say, "A good night's sleep is worth its weight in gold".
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men, ehtimol, ko'p vaqtimni yotoqxonamda o'tkazaman, ayniqsa kechqurunlari va dam olish kunlari.

Uxlashdan tashqari, men yotoqxonamdan shaxsiy ish joyi sifatida foydalanaman. U yerda dars tayyorlaydigan, qog'ozlarni baholaydigan va onlayn tadqiqotlar olib boradigan stolim bor. U mening chalg'ituvchi omillarsiz diqqatimni jamlay oladigan shaxsiy panohimga aylandi.

Bundan tashqari, u yerda uxlashdan oldin kitob o'qib yoki musiqa tinglab dam olishni yoqtiraman. Bu mening uzoq kundan keyin hordiq chiqaradigan muqaddas joyim. Aytishlaricha, "Yaxshi uyqu - oltinning o'rnini bosadi".

vocabulary.title: Q4 - What do you see in these pictures?

questions.sampleAnswer:
These two pictures show different social interactions between people.
In the first picture, I can see what appears to be a family saying goodbye to a young man, probably their son. He's dressed in a formal suit with luggage, suggesting he might be leaving for work or a trip. The elderly couple and a woman are waving to him as he stands by a car. It's an emotionally touching scene.
The second picture shows two men in a shoe store. One is sitting and examining shoes while the other, who appears to be a shop assistant or friend, is helping him choose. They seem to be actively discussing the options available.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu ikki rasmda odamlar o'rtasidagi turli ijtimoiy munosabatlar ko'rsatilgan.

Birinchi rasmda, menimcha, bir oila yosh yigit, ehtimol ularning o'g'li bilan xayrlashayotganini ko'rishim mumkin. U rasmiy kostyumda va yuk bilan kiyingan, bu uning ishga yoki sayohatga ketayotganini ko'rsatadi. Keksa er-xotin va bir ayol unga mashina yonida turganida qo'l siltab turishibdi. Bu hissiy jihatdan ta'sirli sahna.

Ikkinchi rasmda poyabzal do'konida ikki erkak ko'rsatilgan. Ulardan biri o'tirib poyabzallarni ko'zdan kechirmoqda, ikkinchisi esa, do'kon sotuvchisi yoki do'sti bo'lib tuyuladi, unga tanlashda yordam bermoqda. Ular mavjud variantlarni faol muhokama qilishayotganga o'xshaydi.

questions.prompt: How do you usually say goodbye to friends or family members?
questions.sampleA2:

questions.sampleB1:
Usually, I say goodbye with 'bye' or 'see you later'.

If it's a friend I see often, it's a quick goodbye.

However, if it's family or a close friend leaving for a long time, I give them a hug.

I think it's important to say goodbye properly.
questions.sampleB2: Well, it really depends on who it is. With close friends I see regularly, I just wave them off with a 'see you later'. But with family, especially if someone's heading off on a trip, we make a fuss — a big hug, and the elders give their blessings. To be honest, I'm not one for drawn-out goodbyes; I'd rather keep it short and sweet.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men xayrlashaman. Men "xayr" va "ko'rishguncha" deyman.

Ba'zida do'stlarimni quchoqlayman, lekin har doim emas.

Chunki men ularni tez orada yana ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Odatda, men do'stlar yoki oila a'zolariga "xayr" yoki "ko'rishguncha" deb xayrlashaman.

Agar tez-tez ko'rishadigan do'stim bo'lsa, tezda xayrlashaman.

Lekin, agar uzoq vaqtga ketayotgan oila a'zosi yoki yaqin do'stim bo'lsa, ularni quchoqlayman.

Menimcha, to'g'ri xayrlashish muhim.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Do'stlar yoki oila a'zolari bilan xayrlashish uslubim odamga va vaziyatga qarab o'zgaradi.

Doimiy ko'rib turadigan do'stlarim bilan oddiy xayrlashganda, "ko'rishguncha" yoki "xayr" deyish kifoya.

Ammo, oila a'zolarim yoki yaqin do'stlarim bilan xayrlashayotganda, ayniqsa, ular sayohatga ketayotgan yoki ko'chib o'tayotgan bo'lsa, men ko'proq mehr ko'rsatishga harakat qilaman.

Odatda ularni quchoqlab, sog'inishimni aytaman.

Menga o'z his-tuyg'ularimni ifoda etish muhim, ayniqsa, bir-birimizni yana ko'rishimizga ancha vaqt ketishi mumkin bo'lsa.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - How do you usually say goodbye to friends or family members?
idioms: Parting is such sweet sorrow - "Ajralish shirin qayg'u"
sentenceStarters: "The way I say goodbye really depends on..." - "Xayrlashish usulim ... ga bog'liq"
"For casual, everyday goodbyes..." - "Oddiy, kundalik xayrlashuvlar uchun..."
"However, for more significant farewells..." - "Biroq, muhimroq xayrlashuvlar uchun..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
The way I say goodbye really depends on the situation and how long we'll be apart.
For casual, everyday goodbyes – like when my family leaves for work – we typically just say "ko'rishguncha" which means "see you later" and maybe give a quick wave, similar to what we see in the first picture.
However, for more significant farewells, like when someone is traveling abroad or moving away, we have more elaborate rituals. In Uzbek culture, we often hug, and elders might give blessings. There's usually an emotional moment, sometimes tears.
I personally prefer warm hugs and expressing that I'll miss the person. As they say, "Parting is such sweet sorrow".
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xayrlashish uslubim vaziyatga va qancha vaqtga ajralishimizga bog'liq.

Oddiy, kundalik xayrlashuvlar uchun – masalan, oilam ishga ketayotganda – biz odatda shunchaki "ko'rishguncha" deymiz, bu "keyinroq ko'rishamiz" degan ma'noni anglatadi va ehtimol birinchi rasmda ko'rganimizga o'xshab tezda qo'l siltaymiz.

Ammo, kimdir chet elga sayohat qilayotganda yoki ko'chib ketayotganda kabi, yanada muhim xayrlashuvlar uchun bizda yanada murakkab marosimlar mavjud. O'zbek madaniyatida biz ko'pincha quchoqlashamiz va kattalar duo berishlari mumkin. Odatda hissiy lahza bo'ladi, ba'zan ko'z yoshlar ham bo'lishi mumkin.

Men shaxsan iliq quchoqlashishni va odamni sog'inishimni bildirishni afzal ko'raman. Aytishlaricha, "Ayriliq shunday shirin g'am".

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Have you ever helped anyone to choose anything new to buy?
idioms: Two heads are better than one - "Ikki bosh bitta boshdan yaxshi"
sentenceStarters: "Yes, absolutely! I've helped..." - "Ha, albatta! Men ... ga yordam berdim"
"The most memorable time was when..." - "Eng esda qolarli vaqt ... edi"
"I believe getting a second opinion is..." - "Men ikkinchi fikr olish ... deb o'ylayman"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, absolutely! I've helped friends and family make purchasing decisions on numerous occasions.
The most memorable time was when I helped my younger brother choose his first laptop for university. He was completely overwhelmed by all the options available. I researched different models, compared specifications, and we visited several stores together before making the final decision.
I've also helped friends choose clothes and shoes, much like the scene in the second picture. It's actually quite enjoyable to offer advice and see their satisfaction when they find something perfect.
I believe getting a second opinion is valuable when making important purchases. As they say, "Two heads are better than one".
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, albatta! Men do'stlarim va oilamga ko'p marta xarid qilish qarorlarini qabul qilishda yordam berganman.

Eng yodda qolarlisi, ukamga universitet uchun birinchi noutbukini tanlashda yordam berganim bo'lgan. U mavjud bo'lgan barcha variantlardan butunlay hayratda edi. Men turli modellarni o'rgandim, texnik xususiyatlarini taqqosladim va yakuniy qarorni qabul qilishdan oldin bir nechta do'konga birga bordik.

Men do'stlarimga kiyim va poyabzal tanlashda ham yordam berganman, xuddi ikkinchi rasmdagi sahnaga o'xshab. Maslahat berish va ular mukammal narsani topganda ularning qoniqishini ko'rish juda yoqimli.

Menimcha, muhim xaridlarni amalga oshirishda ikkinchi fikrni olish juda qimmatli. Aytishlaricha, "Ikki bosh bir boshdan yaxshi".

questions.sampleA1: I like fruit. I eat fruit. It is good for me.
questions.sampleA2: I like to eat healthy food. I like apples and bananas. I don't like junk food because it is bad for me. I also like to walk in the park sometimes.
questions.sampleB1: I try to have a healthy lifestyle. I think it's important to eat well and exercise. For example, I usually cook at home instead of eating fast food. Also, I try to go to the gym a few times a week. However, it's not always easy to be healthy.
questions.sampleB2: Right, health and lifestyle is something I feel quite strongly about, so I've got plenty to say. First off, do women pay more attention to their health than men? On the whole, I'd say yes. In my experience, women are far more likely to book in for regular check-ups and take preventive care seriously, whereas a lot of men tend to brush off symptoms until things get really serious. I suppose it comes down to this old-fashioned idea that men are meant to be tough and just soldier on, which, if you ask me, does them no favours at all. As for whether governments could do more, absolutely. The thing is, they hold a lot of the cards here. They could roll out more affordable sports facilities, crack down on junk-food advertising, and make fresh produce cheaper through subsidies. Honestly, education plays a huge part too — teaching kids about nutrition from an early age would pay off in the long run. At the end of the day, if the healthy choice is also the easy, cheap choice, people are far more likely to stick to it. And finally, do people worry more about their health as they age? Definitely. When you're young, you feel more or less invincible and you take your health for granted. But once you hit a certain age, or you have a bit of a scare, it really hits home how precious it is. As the saying goes, prevention is better than cure, and that message tends to land harder the older we get.

Misol uchun, odatda tez ovqatlanish o'rniga uyda ovqat tayyorlayman. Shuningdek, haftada bir necha marta sport zaliga borishga harakat qilaman.
Biroq, har doim ham sog'lom bo'lish oson emas.
questions.uzSampleB2: Sog'lom turmush tarzini saqlash men uchun, albatta, ustuvor vazifa, garchi bunga erishish har doim ham oson bo'lmasa ham. Men ko'plab meva va sabzavotlardan iborat muvozanatli ovqatlanishga e'tibor berishga harakat qilaman va muntazam ravishda jismoniy mashqlar qilishga urinaman. Biroq, menimcha, sog'liqning ruhiy jihati ham bor. Stressni boshqarish va yetarli uxlash ham xuddi shunday muhim. Bundan tashqari, men hukumatlar ta'lim va ommabop resurslar orqali aholi salomatligini targ'ib qilishda katta rol o'ynashi kerak, deb hisoblayman.

bulletPoints: Do women pay more attention to their health than men?
Could governments do more to promote healthier lifestyle options?
Do you think most people worry more about their health as they get older?
questions.sampleAnswer:
Women vs men and health:
Generally speaking, I believe women do tend to pay more attention to their health than men. Statistics show that women visit doctors more regularly for check-ups and preventive care. Men, on the other hand, often ignore symptoms and avoid seeking medical help until problems become serious. This might be due to societal expectations that men should be tough.
Government role in promoting health:
I definitely think governments could do more to promote healthier lifestyles. They could invest in more public sports facilities, create better cycling infrastructure, and implement stricter regulations on junk food advertising. Additionally, making healthy food more affordable through subsidies would help.
Health concerns and aging:
Yes, I absolutely believe people worry more about health as they age. When we're young, we often feel invincible. But as we get older and perhaps experience health issues, we become more health-conscious. As they say, "Health is wealth" – and this becomes clearer with age.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ayollar va erkaklar va salomatlik:
Umuman olganda, menimcha, ayollar o'z sog'lig'iga erkaklarga qaraganda ko'proq e'tibor berishadi. Statistika shuni ko'rsatadiki, ayollar tekshiruvlar va profilaktika uchun shifokorlarga ko'proq muntazam ravishda tashrif buyurishadi. Erkaklar esa ko'pincha alomatlarga e'tibor bermaydilar va muammolar jiddiy bo'lmaguncha tibbiy yordam so'rashdan qochishadi. Buning sababi erkaklar kuchli bo'lishi kerak degan ijtimoiy kutishlar bo'lishi mumkin.
Sog'liqni targ'ib qilishda hukumatning roli:
Men hukumatlar sog'lom turmush tarzini targ'ib qilish uchun ko'proq ish qilishi mumkin deb o'ylayman. Ular ko'proq jamoat sport inshootlariga sarmoya kiritishlari, velosiped infratuzilmasini yaxshilashlari va zararli oziq-ovqat reklamalariga nisbatan qat'iyroq qoidalarni joriy etishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, subsidiyalar orqali sog'lom ovqatni arzonroq qilish yordam beradi.
Sog'liq bilan bog'liq xavotirlar va qarish:
Ha, men odamlar yoshi ulg'aygan sari sog'lig'i haqida ko'proq tashvishlanishiga ishonaman. Yoshligimizda o'zimizni mag'lubiyatga uchratib bo'lmaydigandek his qilamiz. Ammo yoshimiz o'tishi bilan va ehtimol sog'lig'imiz bilan bog'liq muammolarga duch kelganimizda, biz sog'lig'imizga ko'proq e'tiborli bo'lamiz. Aytishlaricha, "Sog'lik – boylik" – va bu yillar o'tishi bilan yanada aniqroq bo'ladi.

questions.prompt: Are alternative energy sources effective and justified?
questions.sampleA1: Energy good. Sun good. Wind good. I like.
questions.sampleA2: Sun and wind are energy. I think it's good. It's clean energy and it's important. But maybe it's expensive.
questions.sampleB1: I think alternative energy is a good idea. It's better for the environment than oil or gas. For example, solar panels and wind turbines don't pollute the air as much. However, I know that it can be expensive to build them, and sometimes they don't produce enough energy.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really hot topic these days, and to be honest there are strong arguments on both sides, so let me weigh them up. On the one hand, the people in favour make a compelling case. Renewables like solar and wind are clean — they barely produce any emissions, which is exactly what we need if we're serious about tackling climate change. On top of that, although the upfront costs are steep, they pay for themselves over time because the sun and wind won't ever run out. And let's not forget the green sector is churning out millions of new jobs worldwide. On the other hand, the critics do raise some fair points. The big drawback is that these sources are a bit hit and miss — the sun doesn't always shine and the wind doesn't always blow, so reliability is a genuine concern. Added to that, the initial investment can be eye-watering, which is a real stumbling block for poorer countries. Some even argue that manufacturing all those panels and turbines takes its toll on the environment in the first place. Having said all that, where do I stand? Personally, I'm firmly in favour. Yes, there are teething problems to iron out, but the long-term payoff far outweighs the downsides. If we keep pouring money into research, I'm convinced these technologies will only get cheaper and more reliable. At the end of the day, we're borrowing the planet from our children, so it's a shift we simply have to make.

Masalan, quyosh panellari va shamol turbinalari havoni unchalik ifloslantirmaydi.

questions.uzSampleB2:
Muqobil energiya manbalari tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda va menimcha, ular ayrim kamchiliklarga qaramay, asosan oqlanadi. Bir tomondan, ular energiya ishlab chiqarishga nisbatan barqarorroq yondashuvni taklif qiladi, bu qazilma yoqilg'iga bo'lgan qaramligimizni kamaytiradi va iqlim o'zgarishini yumshatadi. Misol uchun, quyosh va shamol energiyasi qayta tiklanadigan va ish paytida minimal emissiya hosil qiladi.

Biroq, ushbu manbalarning samaradorligi ba'zan ularning uzluksiz emasligi va dastlabki yuqori investitsiya xarajatlari tufayli shubha ostiga olinadi. Bundan tashqari, ba'zilar quyosh panellari va shamol turbinalarini ishlab chiqarish jarayoni ham atrof-muhitga ta'sir qilishi mumkin deb ta'kidlaydi.

Umuman olganda, yengib o'tish kerak bo'lgan muammolar mavjud bo'lsa-da, muqobil energiyaga o'tishning uzoq muddatli foydalari xarajatlardan ustun turadi. Biz ularning samaradorligi va arzonligini oshirish uchun tadqiqot va ishlanmalarga investitsiya qilishni davom ettirishimiz kerak.

for: Alternative energy sources are effective and justified due to their low environmental impact.

questions.sampleAnswer:
This is a highly relevant topic in today's world, and there are compelling arguments on both sides.
Proponents of alternative energy argue that these sources are absolutely effective and justified. Firstly, they have a significantly lower environmental impact compared to fossil fuels, producing minimal greenhouse gas emissions. Secondly, while initial costs are high, the long-term benefits are substantial – renewable sources don't deplete. Additionally, the green energy sector creates millions of jobs worldwide.
However, critics raise valid concerns. Solar and wind energy can be intermittent – the sun doesn't always shine, and wind doesn't always blow. The initial investment required is considerably high, which is challenging for developing nations. Some argue that manufacturing solar panels and wind turbines also has environmental costs.
In my opinion, despite the challenges, alternative energy is our best path forward. As they say, "We do not inherit the Earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children".
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu bugungi kunda juda dolzarb mavzu va har ikki tomonda ham ishonarli dalillar mavjud.

Muqobil energiya tarafdorlari bu manbalar mutlaqo samarali va oqlangan deb ta'kidlaydilar. Birinchidan, ular qazilma yoqilg'iga nisbatan atrof-muhitga sezilarli darajada kam ta'sir ko'rsatadi, minimal issiqxona gazlari emissiyasini ishlab chiqaradi. Ikkinchidan, boshlang'ich xarajatlar yuqori bo'lsa-da, uzoq muddatli foyda juda katta – qayta tiklanadigan manbalar tugamaydi. Bundan tashqari, yashil energiya sektori butun dunyo bo'ylab millionlab ish o'rinlarini yaratadi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar asosli xavotirlarni uyg'otadilar. Quyosh va shamol energiyasi vaqti-vaqti bilan bo'lishi mumkin – quyosh har doim ham porlamaydi va shamol har doim ham esmaydi. Talab qilinadigan dastlabki investitsiyalar juda yuqori bo'lib, bu rivojlanayotgan davlatlar uchun qiyinchilik tug'diradi. Ba'zilarning ta'kidlashicha, quyosh panellari va shamol turbinalarini ishlab chiqarish ham atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazadi.

Menimcha, qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, muqobil energiya bizning eng yaxshi yo'limizdir. Aytishlaricha, "Biz Yer sharini ota-bobolarimizdan meros qilib olmaymiz; biz uni farzandlarimizdan qarzga olamiz".
